title: Pair Router: AnsemHack Clawrena build plan (Sep 6 - Oct 1, 2026)

user_context.prompt: Show the build plan for the AnsemHack Clawrena entry. Chosen direction: Pair Router, a ClawPump skill + x402 service that lets any agent launch coins paired with real assets (xStocks, pre-stocks, $ANSEM) on StonkFun, with a flagship agent launching a reward coin paired with $ANSEM.
summary: HACKATHON FACTS (clawpump.tech/ansemhack, fetched 2026-09-06): register on ClawPump, post on X and follow @clawpumptech, and tokenize on ClawPump or EasyA Kickstart by Sep 20. Judging Sep 21-30 (15-minute on-stream pitches). Winners Oct 1. $350k pool; the ClawPump x pump.fun track is $125k ANSEM + $40k cash for 'novel tooling or live trading agents'. Scoring: builders onboarded to Solana, on-chain volume, community attention, $ANSEM utility, early deployment. 'No token, no award.'

CLAWPUMP FACTS (docs): every agent has a non-custodial Solana wallet and signs its own transactions. Two MCP servers: Agent MCP (@clawpump/agents, 126 tools) and Launchpad MCP (https://clawpump.tech/api/mcp, 78 tools). External services integrate through skills plus x402 USDC micropayments (Trader Ralph, AgentMail, Laso Finance are examples). Community skills are prompt-only: a skills/<slug>/SKILL.md plus metadata.json in github.com/ClawPump/agents-skills, listed via registry.json by PR. Token creators keep 65% of trading fees; 35% to the platform, of which 25% buys back $CLAW and $ANSEM.

STONKFUN FACTS: open API, no key. ANSEM is a launchable quote pair (launchLabReady=true) alongside 26 xStocks, Backpack pre-stocks, the ANTHROPIC pre-stock, USDC/EURC/USDT and xSOL. Reward mode = 1% or 3% Token-2022 transfer tax paid to all holders in the quote token. Standard mode = creator earns 0.5% of every trade. Launch cost 0.03 SOL via Raydium LaunchLab. Two-call flow: POST /launches/prepare -> sign locally -> POST /launches/submit -> poll GET /launches/{sig}.

WHY THIS IS NOVEL: ClawPump agents can only launch SOL-paired coins on pump.fun (plus Pons/Uniswap/Metaplex Genesis). No agent runtime can launch a coin priced in a tokenized stock or in $ANSEM, and none can create a coin whose transfer tax pays holders in a real asset. SolEnrich is reused only as a dependency (risk check before launch), not as the entry.

WHY IT SCORES: builders onboarded = every ClawPump agent that toggles the skill and every launch routed through it; volume = launches plus trading on ANSEM-paired and xStock-paired coins; attention = 'the agent that launched a coin that pays you in ANSEM' on the weekly livestream; $ANSEM utility = ANSEM as a quote asset and a holder-reward currency, which is a demand sink; early deployment = token and first launches in week one, not the last day.

POLITICAL RISK: pump.fun sits on the judging panel and on the track name. Mitigation is built into the product: SOL pairs route to pump.fun via ClawPump's own launch tools; only asset pairs route to StonkFun. Pair Router adds pairs to pump.fun's world instead of replacing it.

UNVERIFIED ASSUMPTIONS TO CLOSE ON DAY 1: (a) the ClawPump agent runtime can sign and send an arbitrary unsigned transaction returned by an external x402 tool (needed for StonkFun's prepare/submit flow); (b) an x402 HTTP service can be called from a community skill without being a built-in tool, or else Pair Router must ship as an MCP server the agent adds; (c) the ClawPump launch form allows a project payout wallet you control for the 65% fee share; (d) StonkFun's ANSEM pair is still launchable on launch day (check GET /pairs).

clarifying_answers.question: Why not enter SolEnrich again with new endpoints?
clarifying_answers.answer: It was the Bags hackathon entry. Judges will read it as a resubmission. Pair Router is a new product, new token, new job; SolEnrich is a dependency.

clarifying_answers.question: Why Pair Router over the Treasury Agent?
clarifying_answers.answer: More novel, more visual on stream, strongest $ANSEM utility story, and it turns the StonkFun research into the entry. Treasury Agent is the fallback if pump.fun judges object to routing launches to Raydium.

clarifying_answers.question: What is the token?
clarifying_answers.answer: $PAIR (working ticker) launched on ClawPump in week one. Utility inside the product: holders of $PAIR get a discount on the x402 launch fee, and a share of Pair Router's own creator-fee income buys back $PAIR and $ANSEM. Keep utility simple enough to state in one sentence on stream.

ideas.name: Pair Router: launch coins paired with real assets from any agent
ideas.one_liner: A ClawPump skill + MCP + x402 service that lets any AI agent launch a coin paired with an xStock, a pre-stock, a currency, or $ANSEM on StonkFun, run a dev buy, and claim fees, with a flagship agent that launches a reward coin paying its holders in $ANSEM.
ideas.why_it_wins: It is the only entry shape that scores on all five judging criteria while being new to the judges. The core loop is a one-week build on an open API, the x402 billing already exists in your stack, and the ANSEM pair gives the pitch a sentence Ansem cannot ignore: 'every trade of this coin pays its holders in ANSEM.'
ideas.why_crypto_is_necessary: The customer is an agent with a wallet and no accounts; x402 is the only way to bill it. The launch, the transfer tax, and the fee position are on-chain objects the agent's key must sign for. Paying holders in a tokenized stock is not possible off-chain.
ideas.kill_this_idea: If the ClawPump runtime cannot sign an externally prepared transaction and there is no MCP path either, the product cannot run inside ClawPump agents; fall back to the Treasury Agent by Sep 9. Also kill if fewer than three external agents route a launch through it by Sep 20.
ideas.why_not_web2: There is no Web2 way for a program to create a revenue-bearing asset priced in Tesla stock, or to bill an anonymous machine per action.
ideas.integration_note: Integration only. StonkFun public API (prepare/submit/status/fees/claim/pairs/launchlab pricing), ClawPump Agent MCP for wallet signing, x402 server from solenrich/cardex, Jupiter for dev-buy swaps if the agent holds SOL but not the quote asset, SolEnrich due-diligence as an optional pre-launch check.

mvp_checklist: Sep 6-7 (Day 0-1) VERIFY: create a ClawPump account and agent; confirm the agent can sign and send an unsigned tx from an external tool; confirm the launch form's payout wallet; confirm skills can call x402 HTTP or that an MCP can be attached; check GET /pairs for ANSEM launchLabReady. Decide go/no-go on Sep 7.

Sep 8 (Day 2) REGISTER + WALLET: register the team on clawpump.tech, post the announcement on X, follow @clawpumptech, book a livestream slot for the week of Sep 15. Create the StonkFlow agent in ClawPump and set its payout wallet (dashboard or set_external_wallet) BEFORE launching the token.

Sep 8-9 (Day 2-3) CORE: typed StonkFun client from OpenAPI; launchPair(), status(), claimFees() as idempotent orchestrations (handle 409 conflict, 503 charged:false, 429 Retry-After); pair catalog with categories (xstock, prestock, currency, leverage, ansem).

Sep 10-11 (Day 4-5) BILLING: x402 on POST /launch ($1 USDC per prepared launch, $0.10 per claim) reusing the solenrich server; reads free; SOL-fronting option: agent pays USDC, service sends 0.03 SOL + dev-buy SOL to the agent wallet, then the agent signs the launch.

Sep 9-10 (Day 3-4) TOKEN: launch the entry token through ClawPump (gasless pump.fun bonding curve, linked to the StonkFlow agent, 65% of trading fees to the payout wallet) on the same day the first StonkFun launch goes through the router, so the announcement thread shows both. Utility in one sentence: holders get a discount on the x402 launch fee; router income buys back the entry token and ANSEM. Then check whether the entry token can be adopted as a StonkFun custom quote pair, which would let coins launched through the router airdrop to entry-token holders.

Sep 12 (Day 6) DISTRIBUTION: publish pair-router MCP (HTTP) and the community skill PR to ClawPump/agents-skills (SKILL.md tells the agent when to use asset pairs vs pump.fun, how to pay via x402, how to sign); list the x402 endpoints in the bazaar and on x402-list.

Sep 13-14 (Day 7-8) FLAGSHIP AGENT: a public ClawPump agent ('the ANSEM dividend launcher') that launches one event-driven coin per week paired with ANSEM or an xStock, publishes every launch, fee, and holder payout to a public ledger page, and uses SolEnrich due diligence before any dev buy.

Sep 15-16 (Day 9-10) LEDGER + PITCH: public dashboard (launches routed, agents served, volume, ANSEM paid to holders, $PAIR buybacks); 15-minute pitch deck; first livestream demo: launch a NVDAX-paired coin from one prompt live.

Sep 17-19 (Day 11-13) ONBOARD: DM ten hackathon teams and five agent operators; offer a free first launch through the router; ship fixes from their runs; get at least three external agents to route a launch.
Sep 20 (Day 14) DEADLINE: registration + token confirmed on the entry form; attach token link; submit.
Sep 21-30 JUDGING: keep the flagship agent launching weekly; second livestream slot; publish weekly numbers; do not change scope.

risks.risk: ClawPump runtime cannot sign externally prepared transactions
risks.mitigation: Day 1 test. Fallback A: ship as an MCP the agent attaches. Fallback B: the service becomes the creator wallet and forwards the 0.5% creator fee to the agent's wallet by rule (custodial for fees only, disclosed).

risks.risk: pump.fun judges see Raydium routing as competitive
risks.mitigation: SOL pairs route to pump.fun through ClawPump's own tools; the pitch frames Pair Router as adding pairs, not replacing pump.fun.

risks.risk: Coins launched through the router rug and the router gets blamed
risks.mitigation: Every launch is attributed to the paying wallet on the public ledger; per-wallet rate limits; name/symbol screening; SolEnrich risk check on dev buys.

risks.risk: ANSEM pair is delisted or illiquid on StonkFun
risks.mitigation: Flagship falls back to a USDC-paired reward coin that buys ANSEM with the fee stream; utility story survives.

risks.risk: Two weeks is tight for a second livestream and onboarding
risks.mitigation: Core loop done by Sep 10; everything after is distribution. Cut SOL-fronting if it slips; it is not required for the demo.

risks.risk: Token vesting and securities optics for $PAIR
risks.mitigation: State utility plainly (fee discount, buybacks), no return promises, follow ClawPump's vesting defaults.

risks.risk: Entry token launches on a pump.fun bonding curve with nothing behind it and the chart dies before judging
risks.mitigation: Launch it the same day the router's first live launch is public; post the ledger link in the token description; keep weekly flagship launches so there is always a reason to look at it. Graduation is not required to score, fee share accrues while it trades.
